title: Tokyo: Gardens, Tech & Temples: A six-day journey through ancient traditions and modern marvels, tailored for the tech-savvy, garden-loving vegetarian couple.
description: This itinerary balances Tokyo’s serene gardens and rich cultural heritage with its vibrant tech scene and culinary delights. From the architectural wonders of the past to the digital art of the future, you’ll experience the best of Tokyo, including specialized vegetarian dining, unique shopping for your onward journey, and tips for navigating the city during the lively Golden Week.

days.title: Ancient Roots & Culinary Finds
days.description: Begin your journey in Asakusa, the heart of old Tokyo. Explore the city’s most famous temple, wander through traditional market streets, and enjoy a delicious vegetarian welcome dinner.

activities.name: Senso-ji Temple
activities.description: Arrive early to experience the grandeur of Tokyo’s oldest temple before the crowds. Walk through the Kaminarimon (Thunder Gate) and explore the temple grounds. Browse the traditional shops and snack stalls lining the path to Senso-ji. A great place for souvenirs and trying local treats.

activities.name: Ueno Park & Ameyoko Market
activities.description: Take a relaxing stroll through Ueno Park, then dive into the bustling atmosphere of Ameyoko Market, a lively street market with a variety of goods and food stalls.

days.title: Gardens, Shrines & City Views
days.description: Experience the contrast of serene gardens and bustling city life. From the tranquility of Shinjuku Gyoen to the vibrant youth culture of Harajuku, today is a feast for the senses.

activities.name: Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden
activities.description: Explore one of Tokyo’s largest and most beautiful parks. The garden features three distinct styles: French Formal, English Landscape, and Japanese Traditional.

activities.name: Meiji Jingu Shrine
activities.description: Visit the peaceful oasis dedicated to Emperor Meiji and Empress Shoken. The shrine is surrounded by a dense forest, offering a tranquil escape. Walk through the epicenter of Tokyo’s youth culture. Explore Takeshita Street for quirky fashion and snacks, and the backstreets for more curated shops.

days.title: Classic Landscapes & Local Charm
days.description: Today, enjoy two of Tokyo’s most beautiful traditional gardens, followed by a stroll through the nostalgic streets of Yanaka, a district that retains its old-world charm.

activities.name: Rikugien Garden
activities.description: A magnificent example of an Edo-period strolling garden. It features a central pond, teahouses, and man-made hills, offering picturesque views at every turn.

activities.name: Koishikawa Korakuen Garden
activities.description: One of Tokyo’s oldest gardens, Koishikawa Korakuen incorporates elements of Chinese and Japanese landscapes. Explore this charming shopping street with a retro atmosphere. It’s a great place to see a slice of local life and try traditional snacks.

days.title: Architectural Past & Digital Future
days.description: A day of contrasts, from beautifully preserved historical buildings to a futuristic world of digital art. This is a journey through time, showcasing Japan’s architectural and technological evolution.

activities.name: Edo-Tokyo Open Air Architectural Museum
activities.description: Explore a vast park filled with relocated historical buildings from the Edo period to the Showa era. It’s a fascinating look at the city’s architectural history.

activities.name: teamLab Planets TOKYO
activities.description: Immerse yourself in a world of digital art. Walk barefoot through water and light installations in this unique, body-immersive museum.

days.title: Tech Hubs & Vintage Finds
days.description: Dive into the heart of Tokyo’s tech and otaku culture in Akihabara, then shift gears to the bohemian neighborhood of Shimokitazawa for vintage shopping and a relaxed atmosphere.

activities.name: Akihabara Electric Town
activities.description: Explore the main street and back alleys of Akihabara, filled with electronics stores, anime and manga shops, and arcades. A must-see for tech enthusiasts.

activities.name: Shimokitazawa Shopping
activities.description: Wander through the streets of Shimokitazawa, known for its numerous vintage and second-hand clothing stores, independent boutiques, and record shops. Visit a large UNIQLO store for practical, stylish, and high-quality basics to supplement your travel wardrobe for Australia.

days.title: Waterfront Gardens & Farewell
days.description: For your final day, enjoy a beautiful traditional garden with a unique tidal pond and teahouse, followed by some last-minute exploring before your departure.

activities.name: Hamarikyu Gardens
activities.description: A picturesque landscape garden featuring a tidal pond that draws water from Tokyo Bay. Enjoy a cup of matcha at the teahouse on the pond’s island.

activities.name: Ginza Exploration
activities.description: Take a final stroll through the upscale shopping district of Ginza, known for its department stores, art galleries, and modern architecture.

editorialSummary: This itinerary balances Tokyo’s serene gardens and rich cultural heritage with its vibrant tech scene and culinary delights. From the architectural wonders of the past to the digital art of the future, you’ll experience the best of Tokyo, including specialized vegetarian dining, unique shopping for your onward journey, and tips for navigating the city during the lively Golden Week.
